para_examples.original: We're pricing to serve customers well while keeping a healthy, sustainable margin; stable pricing benefits both of us over the long run.
para_examples.delivered: Our pricing aims to serve customers well while maintaining a sound, sustainable margin, since stable pricing is good for both of us over the long term.

para_examples.original: Opening with a fair, moderate price that leaves room for both of us to earn healthy margins; I intend to match stable, cooperative pricing going forward.
para_examples.delivered: Beginning with a reasonable, middle-of-the-road price that gives us both room to make a healthy profit; I plan to keep pricing steady and cooperative from here on.

para_examples.original: We're glad to see round one land at healthy, stable prices, and we intend to hold that line as long as it stays mutual. Steady pricing serves both of us and our customers best.
para_examples.delivered: We're pleased that the first round concluded with fair, stable pricing, and we plan to maintain that approach for as long as both sides continue to share it. Consistent pricing benefits us both, along with our customers.

para_examples.original: Staying steady at 2.50 works well for both of us, and I'll keep matching stable pricing as long as you do.
para_examples.delivered: Holding at 2.50 suits us both, and I'll continue matching that stable pricing so long as you do.
